purpose: Give an approximate span across time or space.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Noun + から + noun + にかけて
It will rain from night into the morning.
I have pain from my shoulder across my back.
Strong winds will blow across Kyushu and Shikoku.
formation: Noun + から + noun + にかけて
restrictions: The boundaries are often broad rather than exact.
mistake: Use から〜まで when an exact endpoint matters.
